description: Slack-style sticker output: cleans each decoded sticker master, writes configured PNG sizes in per-sticker folders, and adds a README with import instructions. No JSON manifest (Slack has no pack-import format).

params.readme_template:
# {display_name} sticker pack

{description}

## Stickers ({sticker_count})

Each sticker has its own folder with PNG exports at these sizes: {size_list}.

{state_list}

## Importing into Slack

1. Open your Slack workspace and click the workspace name -> Tools & settings -> Customize workspace -> Add Custom Emoji.
2. For each sticker, click *Add Custom Emoji*, upload the size you want, and use the suggested `:name:` shortcut.

Slack does not support bulk emoji import via UI.
